requirements.evidence: Core contract is implemented: config gate with silent no-op (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:20-22), JSON POST with 5s timeout (:27), mb-safe truncation to 1800 (:60-61), key/bearer/recursive-array redaction (:70-106), error logs with webhook-URL scrub (:30-35); audit channel at config/logging.php:77-83, stack default daily at config/logging.php:57, LOG_STACK=daily at phpunit.xml:22, and the lane guide at docs/ops/ops-logging.md:1-56. Gaps: the required `daily` channel settings (path, `days` = env('LOG_DAILY_DAYS', 14)) are not in the diff, so archive retention depends on pre-existing config that cannot be verified; the doc's env list omits LOG_STACK (docs/ops/ops-logging.md:52-55).

conventions.evidence: Mostly consistent with Laravel/sibling style and PHPDoc on the public method (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:11-17). But the hard convention 'No production code without a test; everything implemented ships with a test' (conventions.md:15-18) is violated: no tests in the diff. Docs are not fully kept in sync: conventions.md:54 points to docs/ops/logging.md while the change adds docs/ops/ops-logging.md:1, and there is no CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] entry (conventions.md:92-103).

security.evidence: No secret leakage path found: sensitive context keys and Bearer credentials are redacted, nested arrays are recursively redacted (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:72-104); the failure log records only the status code (:30) and the catch block scrubs the configured URL from the exception text before logging (:34-35); the raw webhook URL is never included in any log message or context. No authorization applies to this ops service.

tests.evidence: The diff contains no test files and no test changes at all; the new app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php and the logging-channel changes ship with zero Pest/PHPUnit coverage, leaving truncation, redaction and soft-fail behaviour unverified.

simplicity.evidence: Lean and direct: one small class reusing the Http and Log facades and config() (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:20-35), with two focused private helpers (:42-62, :70-106); no speculative abstractions or duplicated logic. Minor: the sensitive-key list is rebuilt on every redact() call (:72-82).

readability.evidence: Small, well-named methods (buildPayload at app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php:42, redact at :70) and short methods that are easy to follow. Minor blemishes: the catch block overwrites the `$message` parameter with the exception text (:34), redact() has no return type (:70), and config/logging.php:140 now ends without a trailing newline.

scope.evidence: Every file in the diff serves the task: notifier class (app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php), services config (config/services.php:32-34), logging channels (config/logging.php:57,77-83), env/test wiring (.env.example:20,88-91; phpunit.xml:22) and the ops documentation (docs/ops/ops-logging.md). No unrelated refactors or extra features.

issues.location: app/Ops/DiscordOpsAlert.php (new file); no test files in diff
issues.explanation: The change adds production behaviour with no Pest/PHPUnit tests, violating the project's mandatory test-first rule and leaving the security-sensitive redaction, truncation and soft-fail paths unverified.
conventions.md:54 references docs/ops/logging.md, but the new guide is named ops-logging.md, so the existing cross-reference is stale and the new document is not linked from the docs index.
The new notifier, channels and env keys are not recorded under [Unreleased], although the conventions require a Keep a Changelog entry for every change.

The diff never shows the `daily` channel being configured with the required path and `days` => env('LOG_DAILY_DAYS', 14); if the base config did not already have them, the archive-lane retention requirement is unmet.

The documentation's environment-variable block lists LOG_DAILY_DAYS, LOG_AUDIT_DAYS, LOG_AUDIT_LEVEL and DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL but omits LOG_STACK, so the guide is not in sync with the env keys the task introduces.
The catch block reassigns the `$message` parameter to the exception text, which shadows the alert message and makes the flow harder to read; a distinct `$error` variable would be clearer.
The json_encode() result for nested context arrays is unchecked, so an encoding failure would silently emit a `key=` line instead of a JSON value.
The file lost its trailing newline ('\ No newline at end of file'), which is a style regression that Pint/editors will flag.

review.summary: The change adds the DiscordOpsAlert service, an audit log channel, the daily-as-default stack wiring, the new env keys and an ops logging guide, and it meets most of the functional contract including redaction and soft-fail. It cannot be approved as is because it ships no tests for new production code, the docs reference is out of sync with conventions.md and the CHANGELOG is not updated; the archive `daily` retention setting is also not demonstrated in the diff.
